info.name: file-am API
info.description: file-am API: Mobile (auth, user, onboarding, sales, expenses, tax computation, tax payables, payments, filings, reports, analytics, evidence vault, employees, help, settings), Webhooks (payment confirmation), Enterprise (health, company, invitation, onboarding). Sign up via onboarding only (no register endpoint). Payment is handled by a third party; use tax-payables and payments to list due amounts and track payment records. All mobile endpoints under /api/v1/mobile except auth/onboarding; most require Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} and completed onboarding.

item.name: Mobile
item.description: Mobile app endpoints. Base path: /api/v1/mobile. Auth: OTP, login, refresh, logout (no register; use Onboarding to sign up). User (profile, business profile, notification settings, consultant), Onboarding, Sales, Expenses, Tax Computation, Tax Payables, Payments, Filings (VAT/WHT), Reports, Analytics, Evidence Vault, Employees, Help (FAQs, about, contact) — all except Auth OTP/verify/resend and Help FAQs/About require Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} and (where noted) completed onboarding. Replace :id in paths with actual UUIDs or composite ids (e.g. evidence-vault documents use composite ids like sale-<uuid>).

item.name: Auth
item.description: OTP email verification, login, token refresh, logout. Registration is via Onboarding only.

request.description: Sends OTP to the given email. Body: email (required).
Verifies OTP and marks email verified. Body: email, code (required).
Resends verification email. Body: email (required).
Returns accessToken, refreshToken, user. If onboarding incomplete, also returns onboardingToken and currentOnboardingStep.
Register a new user. Body: email, password, firstName, lastName (required). Prefer Onboarding flow for sign-up where possible.
Returns new accessToken. Body: refreshToken (required).
Revokes the refresh token. Body: refreshToken (required).

item.name: User
item.description: Profile, password, business profile, notification settings, consultant. All require Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}} and completed onboarding.

request.description: Returns current user profile (id, email, firstName, lastName, role, etc.).
Updates profile. Body: firstName, lastName, address, state, organizationName, organizationAddress, logo (all optional).
Changes password. Body: currentPassword, newPassword (required).
Returns business profile: businessName, tin, rcNumber, businessType, sector, stateOfResidence, bankAccount, address, logo. Auth + onboarding required.
Creates or updates business profile. Body: businessName, tin, rcNumber, businessType, sector, stateOfResidence, bankAccount, address (all optional).
Returns filingReminders, payersNotifications, complianceUpdates, twoFactorEnabled (booleans). Auth + onboarding required.
Updates notification toggles. Body: filingReminders, payersNotifications, complianceUpdates, twoFactorEnabled (all optional booleans).
Returns assigned consultant: id, name, managingTaxForms (array), status. Null if none assigned.
Revokes consultant access. Body: connectionId (required). Sets connection status to revoked.

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: Business sign-up flow: email (OTP), email-verify (returns onboarding token), password, income-type, tax-obligations, business-details, tax-jurisdiction, consultant-terms. Invite: verify-code, accept-request, reject-request. Use onboarding token in Authorization header for steps after email-verify.

item.name: Sales
item.description: Track revenue and invoices. Requires authentication and completed onboarding. Invoice IDs (e.g. INV-001) are auto-generated by the server.

request.description: Returns sales list with summary (totalIncome, vatCollected), counts (all, paid, pending, overdue), and sales array.
Returns a single sale with full details and amount breakdown (baseAmount, vatRate, vatAmount, total). Path param: id (sale UUID).

Creates a sale. Invoice number (e.g. INV-001) is auto-generated. Body: amount (number, required), description (string, required), customerName (string, optional), paymentType (required: Cash | Transfer | Invoice | Card), date (ISO date, required), vatableIncome (boolean, default false), serviceIncome (boolean, default true). VAT 7.5% applied when vatableIncome is true.

item.name: Expenses
item.description: Track business costs and receipts. Requires authentication and completed onboarding. Expense IDs (e.g. EXP-001) are auto-generated by the server.

request.description: Returns expenses list with summary (totalExpenses, vatClaimable), topCategories (category, amount, percentageOfTotal), and expenses array.
Returns a single expense with full details and amount breakdown. Path param: id (expense UUID).

Creates an expense. Expense number (e.g. EXP-001) is auto-generated. Body: amount (number, required), description (string, required), category (required: Rent | Tools & Software | Marketing | Internet | Other), date (ISO date, required), vatInclusive (boolean, optional), vatAmount (number, optional), receiptUrl (string, optional).

item.name: Tax Computation
item.description: Real-time tax calculations (VAT, WHT, CIT) based on sales and expenses for a given period. Requires authentication and completed onboarding.

request.description: Returns period overview (totalIncome, totalExpenses, netProfit), VAT (outputVat, inputVatClaimable, netVatPayable, threshold info), WHT (serviceIncome, estimatedWhtDeducted), CIT (monthlyProfit, annualizedProfit, estimatedAnnualCit, threshold info).

item.name: Tax Payables
item.description: List of due tax payments (VAT, WHT, CIT) derived from monthly tax computation. Status: pending, paid, overpaid, partially_paid.

request.description: Syncs payables from tax computation (last 12 months) then returns list. Each item: id, taxType, periodLabel, amountDue, penalties, totalPayable, filingDueDate, status, totalPaid.
Returns one payable with payment history (payments array).
Stub: returns reference and amount for third-party integration. Body: method (card | bank_transfer | cash). Actual payment is done externally; then call webhook to record result.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment history (records from third-party payment). Track which payables are paid, pending, or overpaid.

query.description: Optional. Filter by tax payable UUID.

request.description: Returns payment records for the user (amountPaid, method, status, paidAt, taxType, periodLabel).
Returns one payment record with payable details.

item.name: Filings
item.description: Filings overview (VAT/WHT by period), detail with timeline, document/vault links. VAT: calculation, draft, submit. WHT: schedule, draft, submit.

request.description: Returns filings list: id, taxType, periodLabel, amount, status (overdue/submitted/paid/pending), dueDate, submittedDate.
Returns filing detail with timeline (Draft Created, Reviewed, Submitted to FIRS, Payment Confirmed), documentUrl, evidenceVaultId, receiptUrl, stateOfOperation, vatRegistrationNumber.
Returns document URL for download.
Returns evidenceVaultId for View in Vault.
Returns VAT calculation: period, stateOfOperation, vatRegistrationNumber (from draft if any), outputVat, inputVatClaimable, netVatPayable, breakdown.
Body: periodYear, periodMonth, stateOfOperation (optional), vatRegistrationNumber (optional).
Body: periodYear, periodMonth, amount, dueDate (optional), paymentStatus (Paid | Not paid), receiptUrl, documentUrl, evidenceVaultId, stateOfOperation, vatRegistrationNumber.
Returns WHT schedule: periodLabel, whtType, vendors (vendorName, description, category, grossAmount, whtRate, whtDeducted), totalWht, dueDate.
Body: periodYear, periodMonth, whtType (optional), lines (vendorName, description, category, grossAmount, whtRate, whtDeducted).
Body: periodYear, periodMonth, totalWht, dueDate (optional), paymentStatus (Paid | Not paid), receiptUrl, documentUrl, evidenceVaultId.

item.name: Reports
item.description: List reports, report types, periods, generate, download, vault link.

request.description: Returns list of report types (e.g. VAT Return Summary, WHT Schedule Report).
Returns available periods (year, month, label, value) for report generation.
Body: reportType, periodYear, periodMonth, format (optional, default PDF). Creates report record; status Stored in Evidence Vault when documentUrl/evidenceVaultId set.
Returns reports list: id, name, reportType, periodLabel, generatedAt, format, status.
Returns report detail: format, periodLabel, generatedAt, status, documentUrl, evidenceVaultId.
Returns document URL for download.
Returns evidenceVaultId for View in Vault.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Reports & Analytics dashboard: KPIs (income, expenses, net profit, margin) with % vs previous period, P&L, 6-month income trend, expense breakdown by category, business health. Auth + onboarding required.

request.description: Returns kpis (income, expenses, netProfit, margin, percentChange*), profitAndLoss, incomeTrend (last 6 months), expenseBreakdown (category, amount, percentageOfTotal), businessHealth (Profitability, Tax Compliance, Cash Flow).

item.name: Evidence Vault
item.description: Secure document storage for audits. Aggregates from Sales (invoices), Expenses (receipts), Filings, Reports. List with search and category filter, get document detail, download URL. Auth + onboarding required.

query.description: all | invoices | receipts | vat_schedules | wht_notes | filings

request.description: Returns documents array (id, documentId, name, category, source, date, fileSizeKb, documentUrl, evidenceVaultId) and categoryCounts. Use composite id (e.g. sale-xxx, expense-xxx) for get/download.
Path param id: composite id from list (e.g. sale-<uuid>, expense-<uuid>, payable-<uuid>, report-<uuid>). Returns document metadata and URLs.
Returns { url } for document download. 404 if no documentUrl stored.

item.name: Employees
item.description: Manage payroll and compliance. List employees with PAYE/pension obligations, get employee detail (salary structure, deductions, employer cost), add employee. Nigerian PAYE/pension (8%+10%)/NHF applied. Auth + onboarding required.

request.description: Returns totalEmployees, monthlyPayroll, obligations (paye, pension with amount/status/note), and employees array (id, fullName, jobTitle, employmentType, employeeId, grossPay, paye, netPay).
Returns paye (amount, status, dueDate, note) and pension (amount, status, note). Due 10th of next month for PAYE.

Returns full detail: salaryStructure (basicSalary, allowances, grossPay), deductions (pensionEmployee, nhf, paye, netPay), employerObligations (pensionEmployer, totalMonthlyCost), startDate, stateOfResidence, tin, pensionRsa.

Creates employee. EmployeeId (TH001, TH002...) auto-generated. Body: fullName, jobTitle, employmentType, basicSalary (required); housingAllowance, transportAllowance, mealAllowance, otherAllowances, stateOfResidence, startDate, tin, pensionRsa (optional). PAYE/pension/NHF calculated automatically.

item.name: Help
item.description: Help Center FAQs (by category), About FileAm, Contact Support. FAQs and About are public; Contact requires auth + onboarding.

query.description: Optional. All | VAT | WHT | PIT | CIT | Filing | Other

request.description: Returns categories array and faqs array (question, category). No auth required.
Returns tagline, mission, taxCoverage (name, rate), footer. No auth required.
Submits support request. Body: subject, message (optional). Returns success and response time note. Auth + onboarding required.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Called by third-party payment provider to record payment results. Secure with X-Webhook-Secret or PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

request.description: Creates a payment record and updates TaxPayable status (pending/paid/overpaid). Idempotent by externalReference. Required: taxPayableId, userId, amountPaid. Optional: externalReference, externalPaymentId, method, status, paidAt, metadata.

item.name: Enterprise
item.description: Enterprise endpoints: health check, company, invitation, onboarding (business flow), consultant onboarding (7-step firm flow).

request.description: Health check. No auth required.
Creates a company. Body: name (required). Returns company id.
Creates an invitation for a business. Body: companyId, invitedEmail, invitedBusinessName (optional), expiresInHours (optional).

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: Enterprise onboarding: step email (send OTP), step email-verify. No auth required.

request.description: Sends OTP to email. Body: email, firstName (optional).
Verifies OTP. Body: email, code (required).

item.name: Consultant onboarding
item.description: Enterprise consultant onboarding (7 steps + review & activate). Base path: /api/v1/enterprise/consultant-onboarding. Step 1 returns consultantOnboardingToken; use X-Consultant-Onboarding-Token or body.consultantOnboardingToken for steps 2–7, profile, review-submit, activate.

request.description: Creates session and firm identity. Body: businessStructure, firmName, registrationType, countryOfRegistration (required); rcNumber, yearOfIncorporation (optional). Returns consultantOnboardingToken and session.
Returns full onboarding session (firm identity, partners, scope, subscription, payment, compliance). Requires consultant onboarding token.
Principal partner and certifications. Body: numberOfPartners, principalPartner (fullName, email, phone, yearsOfExperience, certifications[] with qualificationName, issuingBody, year, national).
Additional partners. Body: additionalPartners[] (partnerName, role, yearsOfExperience, certifications[] with qualification, issuingBody, national, year).
Body: primaryState, businessSizeServed (required); additionalStates[], taxTypesSpecializations[] (optional). businessSizeServed: Micro | Small | Medium | Large | Multinational.
Body: billingOption (required); enableAutomatedComplianceReminders (boolean); perFilingReminderConfig[] (filing, frequency, reminderDates[]).
Body: paymentMethod (required); bankAccountNumber, warrantApproval, selfRemittance (optional). paymentMethod: direct_debit | bank_transfer | card | custom_invoice.

Document URLs (optional): cacDocumentUrl, principalPartnerIdUrl, professionalCertificateUrl, amlDocumentUrl, firmProfileUrl. Declarations (required booleans): declarationAccuracy, declarationFirsCompliance, declarationSuspensionPolicy. saveAsDraft: true to save without submitting.
Marks submission for review (documents reviewed in 24–48 hours). Requires step 7 submitted (saveAsDraft false).
Activates the consultant onboarding account. Sets status to activated and currentStep to 8.
